meta.name: airunway-aks-setup
meta.description: Set up AI Runway on AKS — from bare cluster to running model. Covers cluster verification, controller install, GPU assessment, provider setup, and first deployment. WHEN: "setup AI Runway", "onboard AKS cluster", "install AI Runway", "airunway setup", "deploy model to AKS", "GPU inference on AKS", "KAITO setup on AKS", "run LLM on AKS", "vLLM on AKS", "set up model serving on AKS", "AI Runway controller".

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会在已有 AKS 集群上按 6 步引导:校验集群、装 AI Runway 控制器、评估 GPU、选装推理 provider、部署第一个模型并确认就绪。每步先报状态,安装或部署前先问你确认。
howto.when: 当你说「setup AI Runway」「install AI Runway」等,或要求把模型部署到 AKS 时触发。前提是已有 AKS 集群;没有集群会先转给 azure-kubernetes 去创建。

howto.what_en: On an existing AKS cluster, Claude walks six steps: verify the cluster, install the AI Runway controller, assess GPUs, pick an inference provider, deploy a first model, verify Ready. It reports status and asks before installing.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "setup AI Runway", "install AI Runway" and similar, or ask to deploy a model to AKS. Needs an existing AKS cluster; without one it hands off to azure-kubernetes.
